description: Erection of a roof/Loft extension to provide an additional storey with addition of two dormer windows and rooflights.
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-6d1d64e8-7fff-b18b-09b4-035cb7d9a7c6"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed development, by reason of its detailed design, </span></span><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial; font-size: 11pt;">scale, massing, location, and materials, </span><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">would result in an incompatible and obtrusive form of development in a terrace where an unbroken roof line remains, and would result in the loss of the original distinctive valley roof of the building, failing to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the Well Street Conservation Area and the terrace that it forms part of. As such, the proposal is contrary to policies </span><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: transparent; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character), LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets) and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033  (2020) and policies D3 (Optimising site layout through the design-led approach), D4 (Delivering good design) and HC1 (Heritage conservation and growth) of The London Plan (2021), and Hackney's 'Residential Extensions and Alterations' SPD (2009).</span><span style="white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: transparent; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; vertical-align: baseline;"> </span></p>
